text.p: Tropical Cyclone Melanie, in the southern Indian Ocean, has become a major threat to shipping. Top winds are near 115 mph. Strengthening is expected during the next 24 hours when top winds may reach 120 mph. The storm is currently centered near 10.5s/85.0e, moving west at 5 mph. A turn to the southwest is expected during this period. It may weaken some in 48 hours.

Tropical Cyclone 07B has top winds near 40 mph and is centered near 16.1n/87.5e, and moving west about 7 mph. This system is expected to intensify during th next 36-48 hours with top winds reaching 65-75 mph by the time the storm makes landfall along the East Central coast of India in about 36 hours, bringing strong winds and heavy rainfall.

Tropical depression 36w has formed well southeast of Guam. This system should become an increasing risk to shipping as it strengthens during the next 48-72 hours. It should be a tropical storm in about 24 hours and it may be a typhoon in 72 hours. It is expected to threaten Guam in about 72 hours.

A disturbance in the southwest Pacific, near 6n/132e is being watched as it may become a tropical depression during the next 24 hours. It is moving towards the west in the region to the southeast of Mindanao.
